topography.encoding: MSB int16 meters, 5760 x 11520, areoid-relative topography
topography.citation: Smith, D.E., et al., Mars Orbiter Laser Altimeter (MOLA) Mission Experiment Gridded Data Records, NASA Planetary Data System. Instrument summary: Smith et al. (2001), J. Geophys. Res. 106, 23689–23722, doi:10.1029/2000JE001364.
topography.tiles: public/terrain/*.bin are area-averaged clips of this grid. Real MOLA, not synthetic.

faults.product: USGS SIM 3292 Global Geologic Map of Mars, structure layer
faults.citation: Tanaka, K.L., Skinner, J.A., Jr., Dohm, J.M., Irwin, R.P., III, Kolb, E.J., Fortezzo, C.M., Platz, T., Michael, G.G., and Hare, T.M., 2014, Geologic map of Mars: U.S. Geological Survey Scientific Investigations Map 3292, doi:10.3133/sim3292.
faults.notes: Lines are real SIM 3292 structures, simplified and clipped. They are graben axes and wrinkle-ridge crests, not surveyed fault planes. Dip azimuth defaults to the right-hand normal of the digitized trace. Kinematics are assigned as documented in each feature's kinematics_basis.
